title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 148
paragraphs: And those of Aiolia are as follows: Kyme (which is called Phriconis), Larisai, Neon-teichos, Temnos, Killa, Notion, Aigiroessa, Pitane, Aigaiai, Myrina, Gryneia. These are the ancient cities of the Aiolians, eleven in number, since one, Smyrna, was severed from them by the Ionians; for these cities — that is, those on the mainland — used also formerly to be twelve in number. And these Aiolians happened to settle in a land which is more fertile than that of the Ionians, but in respect of climate less favored.
